values.note: Operator's rates page (2026 site): electric and water site $50 a night ($350 weekly, $900 monthly). Tent sites ($40, $45 on holidays) have 110V power but 'No RVs of any kind are allowed on Tent Sites'; rustic sites (no power or water) $35 + $5 on holidays; rustic cabins $70. Daily visitors $5 per car; holding-tank dump service $20. Read 2026-10-22.

note: Family campground west of Gladwin around a small lake, with a beach, a lake-view trail, kayak and paddleboard rentals and kids' activities; run for 40+ years, under the Meihls family since 2024. Tent sites have power but take no RVs. Seasonal sites are leased by the year (May 1 to October 1), by waiting list for repeat campers. --Claude
summary: Changed fees $40-50 -> $50 flat: the $40 'electric-only' sites are tent sites that take no RVs, so the base is the $50 electric/water site (weekly $350, monthly $900). Added 50-amp, water, pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/store/drinking water, season May 1-Oct 6, operator booking engine (RV Business Tech) and the 3-night holiday minimum. Seasonal sites exist (yearly lease, waiting list) but the operator gives no count; the park sells nightly online and reads as a transient family campground. Phone 989-386-7844 confirmed. Good Sam false / military true left (operator silent).
flags: Price gate: base is exactly US$50 (electric/water site, the cheapest an RV may use; tent sites forbid RVs, and whether RVs may use the $35 rustic sites is not stated) before fees; at the line, not over it. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Grand Rapids 138 km); the family has not stayed here.
